company.name: ZM EXPORTS
company.tagline: DRIVEN BY QUALITY, PURITY, AND STRICT FOOD SAFETY STANDARDS
company.description: ZM Exports is a Pakistan-based manufacturer and exporter of premium Himalayan salt products, committed to delivering quality, authenticity, and reliability to global markets. We specialize in supplying natural Himalayan salt items, including edible salt, salt lamps, decorative products, kitchenware, and therapy products crafted with exceptional care.
company.customManufacturing: On Your Demand: Any size, custom shape, specification, grain size, and private-label packaging can be produced.

shippingTerms.name: Ex Works
shippingTerms.description: Seller makes goods available at factory premises. Ideal for buyers with existing freight arrangements.

shippingTerms.name: Free On Board
shippingTerms.description: Seller delivers goods onto vessel at port of origin. Comprehensive export customs clearance included.

shippingTerms.name: Cost, Insurance & Freight
shippingTerms.description: Seller pays cost, freight, and marine insurance to destination port for complete peace of mind.

qualityStandards: Strict Food Safety & ISO Compliant Processing
